public_body: Easthampton Economic Development And Industrial Commission
overall: The AG treated the minutes complaint as resolved after the Commission sent the missing minutes and the complainant confirmed satisfaction; no violation was found and no order issued, only a reminder of duties.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to provide requested meeting minutes within ten days and that some minutes were never kept or not publicly available.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore consider this matter resolved, but remind the Commission of its obligations under the Open Meeting Law to maintain accurate minutes of its meetings and to provide copies of meeting minutes within ten days of a request.
